purpose:
N38 paired capture: genuine Bazel 9.3.0 vs native bazel-rs for Bazel's full label syntax
(LabelParser / LabelValidator / RepositoryName texts), `@repo` shorthand, target patterns
(TargetPattern.Parser: //..., :all, :*, :all-targets, relative and path-as-target forms, negative
build patterns, the wildcard-conflict warning), `//...` discovery over directories whose names are
invalid package names, glob boundaries, shell-escaped $(location) paths and Latin-1 decoding of
repository-rule .bzl sources. Three byte-identical workspace pairs (main: valid names only; bad:
one invalid label per package; exec: a use_repo_rule repository). Compared: exit status class,
stdout (query labels / built targets / output file bytes) and, for failures, a Bazel error
substring that both sides must contain; the native core message is also checked for verbatim
presence in Bazel's stderr. Harness after artifacts/wording-capture.py (N33): --batch,
--ignore_all_rc_files, private output roots under /tmp/opencode, env -i, umask 022, private copy of
tests/fixtures/builtin_modules/registry, distdir seeded from verified local CAS, scratch removed.
Writes tests/fixtures/label_syntax/reference_receipt.json. Evidence only; no test reads it.
environment: env -i PATH=/usr/bin:/bin LANG=C.UTF-8 LC_ALL=C.UTF-8, private HOME/TMPDIR, umask 022; fresh workspace per row
normalization: workspace/base/scratch paths replaced by <WS>/<BASE>/<SCRATCH>; query stdout compared as sorted lines and in order (stdout_order_equal); build: built target set and output text with bazel-out/{k8,rust}-fastbuild/ as bazel-out/<cfg>/

findings_and_fixes: Bazel lexes the query command residue with the query Lexer (spaces and ASCII punctuation outside */@.-_:$~[] end a word; quotes make one word): 12 unquoted rows with spaces or parentheses are query syntax errors in Bazel. Fix: src/query_expression.rs ports Lexer/QueryParser for the single-literal case (Bazel syntax-error texts; other expressions explicit gaps); the residue is joined by spaces; rows re-expected as Bazel errors and quoted variants added.

Glob boundaries come from GlobCache via PathPackageLocator (a BUILD file only, no name validation): a directory with an invalid package name and a BUILD file is a glob boundary (3 rows: //...:*, //...:all-targets, //glob:*, and //glob:loc contents). Fix: the run-1 change that globbed into such directories was reverted.
query reports a :all package error without the build resolver's while-parsing prefix. Fix: the prefix is build-only; a build row was added.

Rows added for run 2: quoted query literals, residue joining, premature end, quoted-dash literal, build :all from a non-package directory, an explicit label below an invalid-name directory with a BUILD file.
